findings.evidence: The inherited 후배 reveal categorically called 후배님 unnatural, although it is possible as a respectful address in some workplaces and unfamiliar relationships.
findings.fix: Added a local nuance that makes address choice depend on the relationship, role, and workplace custom.

findings.evidence: The V/A-(으)니까 table illustrated its vowel-stem row with noun+copula 집들이니까 and its consonant-stem row with vowel-stem 계시다.
findings.fix: Replaced the rows with 바쁘다→바쁘니까 and 많다→많으니까 while preserving the separate noun+이다 row.

findings.evidence: The -지만 note claimed there are no sound changes, contradicting the actual tensing in forms such as 봤지만 [봗찌만].
findings.fix: Qualified the pronunciation note with the coda-triggered tensing and retained the correct 어렵지만 consonant behavior.

findings.evidence: The dialogue asked whether similar ages permit saying 동갑, but 동갑 requires the same age, not merely a similar age.
findings.fix: Changed the Korean and English dialogue line to the exact same-age condition.

findings.evidence: The housewarming-custom boss item accepted 잖아요 but also offered a grammatical 더라고요 sentence while asking only which sentence naturally explains the custom.
findings.fix: Scoped the prompt to reminding a listener of a familiar custom, which uniquely tests 잖아요.
